name: Youth Commission
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on youth and teen programs. You write a yearly work plan and help update the youth and teen master plan.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 who live in Encinitas. Up to 9 members serve.
duration: 1 year term. Meetings run September through June.
deadline_text: As of Nov 2, 2026 the city lists 0 open seats and no recruitment dates. Open seats usually wait for the next yearly recruitment.
how_to_apply: Ask when the next sign up starts. Contact Elle Camarena at ecamarena@encinitasca.gov. You can also call 760-943-2261. The City Council picks the members.
notes: No seats are open right now. Meetings are the first Wednesday of the month at 4:30 PM at City Council Chambers. If you miss three meetings in a row, you lose your seat.
